A mouse and a cat lived in a small house near the market in Cebu. The mouse was quick and the cat was slow. Every day the mouse ran past the stall of Aling Nena to find a little bread. Aling Nena sold pandesal for 5 pesos. "Don't run so fast," said Aling Nena, "or you will fall!" The mouse did not stop. It's fun to run, thought the mouse. One day the cat sat by the door and waited. The mouse came back with a crumb. The cat jumped, but the mouse was too fast. Now they are friends, and they live by the sea.
